tasks.title: Fix headless CI false-fail: mandatory asset-import pass
tasks.notes: Root cause of the get_height()-on-null errors / 2 failing worldrender checks on main: .godot/imported/ is gitignored, so a checkout whose .ctex cache predates a texture-adding commit (TASK-006) gets null loads headlessly. Not a WorldRender.gd bug -- no art-squad file changed. Added scripts/ci/run_gate.sh (runs `godot --headless --import` then either/both test suites) and documented it in both test files' headers. Both gates confirmed green after the fix: engine 48/48, content 54/54 (was 52/54).
